title: Editor crash on startup using --display-driver wayland
body:
### Tested versions

- Godot 4.6.1.stable.gentoo.14d19694e
- Godot 4.6.1.stable.official.14d19694e

### System information

Note that I can't get far enough into the editor to get to the Help -> Copy System Info button when launching with wayland, so I just launched with x11 and replaced `X11 Display Driver` with `Wayland Display Driver`. If I need to fix that let me know.

Godot v4.6.1.stable (14d19694e) - Gentoo 2.18 on Wayland - Wayland display driver, Multi-window, 3 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - AMD Radeon RX 9070 XT (radeonsi, gfx1201, LLVM 20.1.8, DRM 3.64, 6.18.8-gentoo-dist) - AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D 16-Core Processor (32 threads) - 60.45 GiB memory

### Issue description

Whenever I load a project **on KDE Plasma**, it crashes. Loading the project selection menu, i.e. just calling `godot` does not crash. Opening a project either from that menu or from `godot --display-driver wayland -e --path /path/to/project` does crash. 

Here is the backtrace:
```

   at: _poll_events_thread (platform/linuxbsd/wayland/wayland_thread.cpp:3349)

[6] /usr/lib64/libc.so.6(+0x107e7c) [0x7f59ee33ee7c] (??:0)

```

I've also attached a more complete log of the crash [here](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/25614729/godot_crash.txt).

Something weird to note is that I have both swaywm and KDE Plasma installed, and I can only reproduce this bug when using vulkan (forward+ I guess?) in godot **on KDE**. This issue doesn't occur when I'm on sway.


### Steps to reproduce

1. `godot --display-driver wayland -e --path /path/to/project`

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

This happens to me for every project so I don't think providing a reference project is necessary.
